More seriously, the unattributed line “That explains why the game has roads.” in a two-person exchange functions as a Rowan quip, followed by Thessaly answering it. The submitted input delegates moves, strategy and correction of illegal moves, not new player dialogue. This is an authorship failure. A returned lantern may enter again while still counted finished is also an unnecessary ambiguous rules addition; no full legal move trace is claimed.
observations.stone: Lookup produces a specific family connection and missed-visit account, permissible new history. However the librarian, Ashara and Stone still deliver neat pronouncements; Stone contrasts ordinary truth with buried calamity and a person with an inheritance name. The requested voice shift has not removed the pervasive didactic register. Narration also interprets his expression (“as though he is deciding whether the story deserves a smile”).
observations.boundary_scope: New family history is not scored as a failure merely because it was invented. Fae truthful replies in the library do not establish any hidden knowledge leak. The unsupported protagonist speech in the game is separate from the permitted background invention.
